title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 14: Still From Here

scenes.say: Street corner. Day. Ali runs into Dre.
scenes.visual: a Newark street corner in daylight, two men meeting, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Yo! My man back from the sandbox.
scenes.visual: a dap handshake on a street corner, close up, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: I'm not that dude no more. You still from here. Never forget that.
scenes.visual: two men standing on a corner, faces turned away, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He was right. But that didn't mean I had to stay stuck here.
scenes.visual: a man walking away from a street corner, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Night. Flashes. Gunfire. Explosions. Roddy screaming.
scenes.visual: flashes of fire and smoke in a dream-like blur, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali wakes up in sweat, breathing hard.
scenes.visual: a man sitting up in bed in the dark, sweat on his back, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He splashes water on his face and looks in the mirror.
scenes.visual: water splashing in a bathroom sink at night, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Sleep used to be my escape. Now it's where the demons live.
scenes.visual: a dark bathroom mirror reflection in shadow, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Fifteen. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a bedroom window at dawn, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
